title: Customer support, complaints and payment dispute case management
workflow: Authenticate claimant or establish authorized assistance channel
Capture complaint without exposing private counterparty evidence
Classify severity, legal response window and bank-approved triage owner
Acquire authoritative journal, settlement and channel-authentication evidence
Escalate refund, reversal or dispute under independent finance/rail policy
Communicate resolution with traceable decision and appeal pathway
invariants: Customer support staff cannot directly edit posted journal
Dispute initiation does not itself prove unauthorized activity
Refund/return is a new authorized financial operation with reconciliation
Customer communication avoids disclosing AML investigation details
SLA deadlines require verified local legal/customer policy, not guesswork
Cross-tenant case access must be denied
Complaint evidence retained under lawful privacy and audit policies
acceptance_tests: Support actor cannot issue direct ledger debit
Refund without authorized finance approval denied
Claimant sees only their own case
Unknown external transfer remains under investigation
Duplicate complaint links prior case without losing evidence
independent_gate: Institution complaints policy, applicable dispute rules, payment rail agreements and independent operational/finance tests.
